title: Explorer address parsing
responsibility: Parses and formats branch or commit explorer addresses with category, entity, section and tab selection.

inputs.name: explorerKindCategory.kind
inputs.description: A unit kind string looked up in the declared kind-to-category map. Unmapped values return null; for example, view maps to pages and shell maps to components.

inputs.name: tabOf.location
inputs.description: An explorer location whose category, entity or helper, and section determine which requested tabs are eligible. Platforms and locations without an entity or helper have no selected tab.

inputs.name: tabOf.search
inputs.description: The URL search string passed to URLSearchParams; its tab parameter is filtered by the location's section, category, entity or helper, and default-tab rules.

inputs.name: explorerRoute.path
inputs.description: A pathname to parse, beginning with a slash and naming a branch or lowercase 40-character commit scope before its category, helper, or screen segments. Trailing slashes are ignored, and branch and entity segments are percent-decoded.

inputs.name: explorerRoute.search
inputs.description: An optional URL search string used to select a helper and tab; only tabs allowed for the parsed location are retained. Defaults to the empty string.

inputs.name: canonicalExplorerLocation.location
inputs.description: An explorer location that may contain the legacy details section and its tab. Normalization changes only locations whose section is details.

inputs.name: explorerRoutePath.location
inputs.description: An explorer location to serialize with its branch or commit scope and category, plus any entity, screen, helper, section, and supported tab. Details locations are canonicalized before the path is built.

outputs.name: explorerCategories
outputs.description: The accepted category names in route order: all entity categories followed by platforms.

outputs.name: explorerKindCategory
outputs.description: The category assigned to a recognized unit kind, or null when the kind is absent from the mapping.

outputs.name: explorerSections
outputs.description: The supported entity sections are details and history; an entity without a section is on its overview.

outputs.name: explorerTabs
outputs.description: The declared tab names for overview, details, and history sections. tabOf additionally filters these names by category and location rules.

outputs.name: explorerRoute
outputs.description: A parsed location for a valid branch or full-commit scope, or undefined when the scope, category, screen, entity, or section is invalid. It decodes branch and entity segments and keeps only eligible non-default tabs.

outputs.name: explorerRoutePath
outputs.description: The canonical scoped path for a location, using dedicated paths for screens and function helpers. Entity tabs are query parameters, while helper panes are path segments.

errors.name: URIError
errors.description: Path serialization throws when encodeURIComponent receives branch, entity, helper, or screen-entity text containing an unpaired UTF-16 surrogate.
